alt_text.short: Diagram that shows figure ARCH-02 — Pluggable & Extensible ETL Migration Solution Architecture.
alt_text.long: Consumer & Serving Layer: React Portfolio & Desktop UI, Fabric App & Power BI, VS Code Developer Extension, Typer CLI & Artifact Downloads. Orchestration & Runtimes: FastAPI & SQLite WAL RunService, Fabric Runtime 2.0 Notebook, Pluggable Stage Orchestrator, Stateless Stdio JSON-RPC Worker. Target Platform Providers: Microsoft Fabric Provider, Databricks (Placeholder), Azure Synapse (Placeholder), Snowflake (Placeholder). Portfolio Assessment: Source-Neutral Assessment Engine, Effort & Redacted Evidence, Target-Neutral Workload Profile. Canonical IR & Source SPI: Secure Discovery & Staging, Pure Canonical ETL IR & SPI, Built-In Source Adapters, Future Source Plugins. Legacy ETL Source Estates: Alteryx Designer, Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica IDMC, Future ETL Platforms. Delivery & Secretless CI/CD: Microsoft Entra OIDC Federation. Extensibility & Contract SPI: Target & Source Registry SPI, Versioned IR & Provider ABI, Fail-Closed Scaffolds & Parity. PyPI Packaging & Chrysalis SDL: uv Workspace PyPI Packages, Chrysalis SDL & Zero-Exec Guard. Flows: z_estates to z_ir_sources (Ingest); z_ir_sources to z_assessment (Canonical IR); z_assessment to z_targets (Evaluate & compile); z_targets to z_hosts (Envelopes & receipts); z_hosts to z_consumers (Results & IDE UX); z_hosts to z_delivery_cicd (Deploy dispatch); z_spi_gov to z_targets (Plugin SPI); z_pkg_sdl to z_ir_sources (PyPI & SDL).
